description:
The National Park Service (NPS), Department of Interior (DOI), Martin Luther King Jr National Historical Park, Atlanta Georgia, has a requirement for the following project;
To perform structural reinforcement and porch support installation at the NPS MALU Birth Home located on Auburn Avenue, Atlanta Georgia. The work will address stabilization measures.

This procurement is being set aside for Small Business. If your company is interested, submit your detailed capabilities in writing to demonstrate the same or similar experience to this project. This is not a request for proposal, request for quote, or invitation to bid. No proposal package, solicitation, specification, or drawings are available with this announcement. Response to this announcement is strictly voluntary; no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this Pre-Solicitation announcement, or any follow-up information requests. If you choose to submit a package, clearly identify the park and project on your package (structural reinforcement and porch support installation, Martin Luther King Jr National Historical Park), Identify your socio-economic status for Small Business.

Your response is due no later than 0900hrs/9:00 am Eastern Time on 9 March 2026.

The Government anticipates conducting a competitive acquisition for this requirement. The amount of interest or lack thereof will determine the possibility of a competitive set-aside or full and open competition. All firms should be registered and certified in the Systems for Awards Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov, in order to participate in this requirement. Payments will be made via Electronic Funds Transfer using the data within the SAM registration database.

This pre-solicitation announcement is not a solicitation document, but pre-notice of an upcoming solicitation. Specific instructions on submitting your proposal will be contained in the solicitation documents to be issued on or after the date listed below.

Place of Performance: Martin Luther King Jr National Historical Park (MALU)
Place of Performance Address: 503 Auburn Avenue, Atlanta, Georgia
NAICS Code: 238190; Other Foundation Structure, and Building Exterior Contractors
PSC Code: Z2JZ; Repair or Alteration of Miscellaneous Building
Estimated Cost Range: This projects magnitude is between $25,000.00 and $100,000.00
Estimated Period of Performance: 1 May 2026 to 1 November 2026
Project Description (Scope); The primary objective of the project is to provide
Completed structural reinforcement and porch support installation per the Statement of Work. This requirement involves performing work as defined in the Statement of Work when the solicitation is issued. Detailed requirements and/or specifications will be listed within the solicitation and other attachments as required. A Firm Fixed Price award is contemplated from this solicitation with an award to the offeror(s) providing the best value, based on the evaluation criteria outlined in the solicitation once issued.

The solicitation, Request for Quote (RFQ) and its attachments will be issued electronically. Anticipated publish date: On or about 13 March 2026. The solicitation documents will be posted to SAM.gov | Contract Opportunities. The contracting office will not provide hardcopies or email copies of the solicitation.


Site Visit; Only one site visit will be offered for this opportunity, and the information shall be listed in the formal solicitation when it is published to SAM.gov.
Contracting Officer and Point of Contact information for this requirement is:
Bureau: National Park Service, Contracting Operations (ConOps) East
Contracting Officer: Yanick Bard
Email: yanick_bard@nps.gov

All inquiries and questions shall be submitted in writing by email message; no verbal questions will be accepted. Send your email responses to; yanick_bard@nps.gov.
